title: Synthesis II: 3–4 Sources, One Research Question
goal: The capstone disciplinary-reading task — read four mixed-genre sources (a data summary, a historical document excerpt, a science-style study summary, and an op-ed) on one real question, apply the right discipline-specific move to each, and synthesize all four into one answer. This is PIAAC Level 4–5 territory: "search/integrate/evaluate across multiple dense texts... construct syntheses of similar/contrasting viewpoints" (research/06 §1.11).
